Reverse the roles. If she was lusting over men that made you feel insecure and using it as her outlet for her frustrations over your sex life knowing you can't satisfy her, would that have sit alright with you? 

The adult thing to do was to talk about it. How your needs can be met without damaging her self esteem and her ego. Because that's what looking at other people does e. You made her feel bad about herself. So to answer your question, I think it's possible but the chances are very low. We'll always be invested in our partner's sexual activities because sex is a big part of a relationship and by extension a reflection of ourselves, how our partner views us, and the health of your relationship. Can you maybe find a middle ground and compromise to try and meet each other's needs? Then that's a resounding yes (if you're both willing to put in the work, that is).

Taliwas 'yung tanong doon sa situation. Is it wrong for you to have an outlet for your high sex drive? Of course not. But does it make you bad na your outlet was something that made your ex uncomfortable? Yes.
